flashcard_questions.q: What does the Latin phrase ex nihilo mean in Christian teaching about creation?
flashcard_questions.a: That God created the universe out of nothing.

flashcard_questions.q: What is yawm in the Qur’an’s account of creation?
flashcard_questions.a: A period of time, not necessarily a literal 24-hour day.

flashcard_questions.q: What is imago Dei in Christian belief?
flashcard_questions.a: The belief that humans are made in God’s likeness, giving them unique status.

flashcard_questions.q: What is khalifah in Islamic teaching about creation?
flashcard_questions.a: The role of caretaker of the earth, given to humans by Allah.

flashcard_questions.q: How old does the Big Bang theory say the universe is?
Which Bible verse teaches that humans have dominion over creation?
flashcard_questions.a: Genesis 1:28 — “Rule over the fish in the sea and the birds in the sky.”

flashcard_questions.q: Which Qur’anic verse has been read by some Muslims as describing the Big Bang?
flashcard_questions.a: Surah 21:30, which says the heavens and earth were joined together before being ripped apart.

flashcard_questions.q: What does Genesis 2:7 say God used to form the first man?
Which material does Surah 15:26 say Allah created man from?
What do Young Earth Creationists believe about the age of the universe?
flashcard_questions.a: That it is around 6,000–10,000 years old.

flashcard_questions.q: What view did Pope Francis take on evolution in 2014?
flashcard_questions.a: “Evolution in nature is not inconsistent with the notion of creation.”

flashcard_questions.q: Why do most Muslims reject human evolution from apes?
flashcard_questions.a: Because the Qur’an describes Adam’s special creation from clay.

flashcard_questions.q: Which psalm verse do believers use to express awe at creation?
flashcard_questions.a: Psalm 19:1 — “The heavens declare the glory of God.”

flashcard_questions.q: What does stewardship mean for Christians in relation to the earth?
flashcard_questions.a: Caring for creation responsibly on God’s behalf.

flashcard_questions.q: What did the Prophet Muhammad teach about wasting water?
flashcard_questions.a: “Do not waste water even if you are at a running stream.”

notes: 15 cards: 5 term→definition (ex nihilo, yawm, imago Dei, khalifah, stewardship), 4 belief→source (Genesis 1:28, Surah 21:30, Surah 15:26, Psalm 19:1), 3 argument→view (Young Earth Creationists, Pope Francis 2014, Muslim view of human evolution), 2 fact recall, 1 practice→meaning. Dropped 'interpretations' and 'awe and wonder' as too vague to test cleanly.
